en.name: China Business Mission — Q1 2026
en.description: A curated delegation across Shenzhen, Shanghai, and Beijing with high-context meetings, ecosystem visits, and investor sessions.
en.detailSubtitle: A ten-day mission for senior operators that need real conversations with corporates, investors, and ecosystem builders in China.
en.metaTitle: China Business Mission Q1 2026 | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Join the Q1 2026 China delegation across Shenzhen, Shanghai, and Beijing for curated meetings and ecosystem visits.
en.bodyHtml:
The Q1 mission is built for operators who already see a path to China and need direct, high-context conversations to confirm it. The agenda is built around your commercial objectives, not generic ecosystem tours.

What to expect

  • Curated meetings with relevant corporates and operators.
  • Investor sessions matched to your stage and sector.
  • Ecosystem visits across Shenzhen, Shanghai, and Beijing.
  • Operational briefings on entry, hiring, and partnerships.

br.name: Missao de Negocios China — 1T 2026
br.description: Delegacao curada por Shenzhen, Shanghai e Pequim com reunioes de alto contexto, visitas a ecossistemas e sessoes com investidores.
br.detailSubtitle: Uma missao de dez dias para operadores seniores que precisam de conversas reais com corporates, investidores e construtores do ecossistema na China.
br.metaTitle: Missao de Negocios China 1T 2026 | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Participe da delegacao para a China no 1T 2026 por Shenzhen, Shanghai e Pequim com reunioes curadas e visitas ao ecossistema.
br.bodyHtml:
A missao do 1T e feita para operadores que ja enxergam um caminho para a China e precisam de conversas diretas e de alto contexto para confirma-lo. A agenda e construida em torno dos seus objetivos comerciais, nao de tours genericos de ecossistema.

O que esperar

  • Reunioes curadas com corporates e operadores relevantes.
  • Sessoes com investidores compativeis com seu estagio e setor.
  • Visitas ao ecossistema em Shenzhen, Shanghai e Pequim.
  • Briefings operacionais sobre entrada, contratacao e parcerias.

cn.name: 2026 年第一季度中国商务考察
cn.description: 由深圳、上海、北京组成的精选代表团，安排高质量企业会面、生态走访与投资人交流。
cn.detailSubtitle: 为期十天，面向已经看到中国路径、需要与企业、投资人和生态建设者进行真实高语境对话的高级运营者。
cn.metaTitle: 2026年Q1中国商务考察 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 参加 2026 年第一季度中国代表团，走访深圳、上海、北京，安排精选会面与生态访问。
cn.bodyHtml:
第一季度考察面向已经看到中国机会、需要通过直接高语境对话来确认路径的运营者。议程围绕您的商业目标设计，而非泛泛的生态走访。

行程亮点

  • 与相关企业和运营者的精选会面。
  • 匹配阶段与行业的投资人交流。
  • 深圳、上海、北京的生态走访。
  • 关于市场进入、招聘与合作的运营简报。
